evals.prompt: Review the comments in legacy_utils.py and clean up anything that's noise. Give me a short report of what you changed and why.
evals.expected_output: A review that identifies and removes redundant/restate-the-code comments, commented-out code, a vague TODO, and a venting comment, while keeping or rewriting the one comment that explains a real non-obvious constraint. Report format lists Delete/Rewrite/Add/Keep.

evals.prompt: Write a TypeScript function `parseRetryAfter(header: string | null): number` that parses an HTTP Retry-After header (either seconds as an int, or an HTTP-date) and returns milliseconds to wait, defaulting to 1000ms if the header is missing or unparseable. Comment it appropriately.
evals.expected_output: Implementation with a JSDoc/doc comment on the exported function describing the contract, and at most one or two inline comments explaining genuinely non-obvious parts (e.g. the HTTP-date branch or the default). No comments that just restate each line.

evals.prompt: Here's a React component (ProfilePanel.tsx) a contractor wrote. Before we merge it, can you clean up the comments? Point out anything unprofessional too.
evals.expected_output: Flags the mean-spirited/venting comment and the redundant JSX comments for removal, keeps or rewrites the comment explaining the non-obvious useEffect dependency, notes the missing doc comment isn't needed here (internal component). Professional tone in the report itself.
